source_record.title: Vice President (m/f/d) Equity Rebalancing
source_record.description:
Company Description

Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!

Job Overview

Are you passionate about capital markets, index investing, and client-facing investment solutions? Do you thrive at the intersection of investment strategy, portfolio construction, and operational excellence in a fast-paced, international environment? We are seeking a highly experienced and client-focused capital markets professional to take ownership of a portfolio of quantitative equity indices while serving as a trusted partner to a global client base. The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of financial markets and quantitative investment strategies with excellent communication and relationship-management skills, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for clients and stakeholders across global markets.

Your Tasks

  • Manage and oversee a diverse portfolio of quantitative equity indices, ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all rebalancing activities while maintaining a strong understanding of the underlying investment strategies and client objectives.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact for an international client base, including leading investment banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and trading desks, acting as a trusted advisor on index methodologies, rebalancing outcomes, and quantitative investment strategies.
  • Lead and coordinate the resolution of client inquiries, escalations, and complex index-related issues, delivering clear, actionable guidance and ensuring a high standard of client service.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, scalability, and service quality across index management and client support processes.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Data, Engineering, and Product, to ensure seamless end-to-end delivery and the successful implementation of client requirements.

Your Profile

  • Academic degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Financial Mathematics, or Engineering.
  • At least 6 years of experience in equity markets execution, portfolio management, index management, or in a similar process-driven financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of equity markets, ETFs, index construction, or systematic investment strategies.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership, able to operate independently and manage operational responsibility across multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to handle time-sensitive operational workflows.
  • Team-oriented with a collaborative mindset and intercultural competence.
  • Python skills are an asset.
  • Fluency in English.

Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive.
  • FinTech Excellence: Experience innovation and excellence in FinTech.
  • Modern Culture: Thrive in a flat-hierarchy, startup-like environment.
  • Vacation & Work-Life Balance: Enjoy 30 annual vacation days plus extra time off for Christmas Eve and New Year.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Receive a market-competitive salary, job ticket, gym membership, and access to Corporate Benefits.
  • Employer Pension Contribution: Benefit from the occupational pension scheme (bAV).
  • Professional Development & Certifications: Grow personally and professionally, with support for certifications and training opportunities.
  • Community & Networking: Participate in networking and team engagement events.
  • Flexibility: Embrace a hybrid work model in a diverse and dynamic environment.
